title: Medigy.com
summary: A health innovation discovery platform: crowd-curated technology, use cases, and market signal used as an intelligence surface, not a blog.
detail: Medigy.com is the place where we watch what is actually being adopted. Practitioners and buyers curate technologies, rate use cases, and leave the kind of signal that does not appear in a vendor deck. We use it to find the gap between a category's marketing and its real deployment.

It is a portfolio work because it is a standing research instrument. The same observations that inform a patent filing, a fund brief, or a venture charter can be published there first, dated, and checked by the people doing the work.
Press does not just write about inventions. It owns the surfaces where the market sorts itself out. Medigy is one of those surfaces.
